coverage: LLVM source lines in Atril PDF backend, Atril libdocument factory and source-built Poppler GLib/core; AFL++ source edges in the allowlisted backend and Poppler parser files
parser_family: Atril PDF backend over Poppler GLib; shared Poppler PDF core family also used by Evince and GNOME Papers
shared_parser_family: Poppler 26.11.0 GLib frontend and PDF core (glib/, poppler/)
shared_parser_family_note: Atril is an Evince fork. Its backend/pdf/ev-poppler.cc is its own C++ source, but every PDF syntax decision is made by the same pinned Poppler 26.11.0 archive that the Poppler GLib, Evince and GNOME Papers projects build. It adds a package input path, not an independent PDF parser.
